summary: Iteration 5: validated the 3 new SkillMatch surfaces (Organizer Insights, Volunteer Insights, Volunteer Profile Modal) on live preview URL. Added /app/backend/tests/test_insights.py with 11 pytest cases - 11/11 PASS. Covered: /api/insights/organizer (401 unauth, 403 for volunteer, correct response shape incl. skill_coverage/top_volunteers sort order/event_summary), /api/insights/volunteer (401, 403 for organizer, correct shape, events_by_status consistency), /api/users/{username} (self-view OK, organizer->applicant OK, volunteer->other 403/404, 404 for unknown, 401 unauth). Playwright on live URL verified: organizer login -> Insights tab -> organizer-insights section with all 4 stat cards (stat-events=1, stat-volunteers=1, stat-hours=3hrs, stat-pending=0), Skill Coverage bar (Python coding), Top Volunteers leaderboard (Maya Singh 3h), per-event breakdown (hackathon with 0 accepted / 1 completed). Manage -> clicking view-profile-maya-button opens volunteer-profile-modal showing header 'Maya Singh - Computer Science - @maya', profile-stat-events=1, profile-stat-hours=3, profile-stat-certs=1, skill chips Python/Design/Public speaking, Completed Events table with 'hackathon' row (3 Hrs). close-profile-view-button dismisses modal. Volunteer login (maya) -> volunteer-insights with stat-applied/hours/certificates/matches, status breakdown bars for pending/accepted/completed, Recent Activity list with hackathon event.
critical_code_review_comments: organizer_insights issues one db.users.find_one per accepted/completed application for skill coverage - fine for current scale but should be batched via $in on usernames once volume grows.

GET /api/users/{username} lowercases the username in query but the completed_events lookup uses target['username'] directly - OK because stored usernames are already lowercased in seed. Future-proof: enforce lowercase at write time.

App.js (1189 lines) and server.py (587 lines) are both approaching the split-into-modules threshold. Insights components alone are ~230 lines in App.js; consider extracting Insights.jsx and VolunteerProfileModal.jsx.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded data (maya has 1 completed hackathon = 3 hrs)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new surfaces verified end-to-end. Regression suites: /app/backend/tests/test_insights.py (new, iteration 5), /app/backend/tests/test_enhancements.py (iteration 4), /app/backend/tests/test_skillmatch_api.py (legacy, event-python stale 'completed' artifact). Note: in Playwright, modal 'Loading campus story…' flashes briefly - always wait on profile-stat-events selector before assertions.
